algorithm: Keep the exact original SCNG1 vocabulary and conditional 1/2/3-gram tables. Add absolute-discount interpolated fourgram entries only for three preceding known Han characters; no BOS/UNK/EOS contexts. Missing retained contexts return the original trigram exactly. Pruned direct mass backs off to that same trigram.

trials.name: balanced-fourgram
trials.data: all original Tatoeba train plus the exact E15 selected AISHELL train families

vocabulary: Fixed baseline vocabulary; other characters map to one UNK during fitting, with unchanged per-unseen-glyph IME OOV feature -4

development.gate: Per-domain top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing, top1 character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly increases. Retain individual and stratum regressions.
development.selection: Eligible only: greatest combined top1, lowest combined character errors, highest combined top5, prefer daily-only if tied. Known development sets; no discount/cutoff/weight sweep.

test.gate: Same per-domain nonregression and combined strict top1 gain; selected model only, no post-test tuning. Test only after development hashes freeze.

deployment: Offline pass does not enable the factory. Require short-input/partial-pinyin, progressive result consistency, personal-word protection, Android memory/latency/lifecycle and notices before adoption. External editor capture remains unchanged in this initial experiment.
